name: 30907 · Martinez, GA
findings: ZIP 30907 (Martinez) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30907 (Martinez) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
